intuition: In postfix notation, each operator combines the two most recently produced operands.

brute_force.approach: Repeatedly locate an operator and replace it with the result of its preceding operands.

optimal.approach: Use a stack; pop the right operand before the left operand for each operator.

edge_cases: Division truncates toward zero rather than rounding down.
Subtraction and division are not commutative, so operand order matters.
